authority: Direct user instructions in control agent, 2026-10-27 Europe/Moscow
supersedes_for_next_run: Conflicting input gates in title_name_regression_spec_20261026.json; the frozen prior spec and completed runs remain unchanged

instrument_returns.basis: Observed price returns; full dividend/coupon/corporate-action reconstruction is not a prerequisite for the next simplified run
instrument_returns.missing_payout_information: Omit under explicit approximation; do not describe payouts as verified absent
instrument_returns.available_event_evidence: Retain existing flags and evidence; do not erase known identity conflicts or interpret planned maturity as actual payment
instrument_returns.missing_quotes: Not authorized to replace missing security prices or returns with zero
instrument_returns.reporting: Price-based revaluation adjustment under user assumptions; not verified total-return AT

cash_and_deposits.disclosed_deposit_income: Use available disclosed evidence; do not overwrite with assumed zero
cash_and_deposits.unknown_non_cash_assets: Not covered by the zero-interest assumption
cash_and_deposits.foreign_cash: Zero interest does not by itself imply zero RUB foreign-exchange revaluation
cash_and_deposits.RUONIA: Money-market reference for risk adjustment; do not automatically credit idle fund cash with RUONIA

controls.additional_full_control_requirements: Dropped at user's request; no blocker for historical size, security volatility/illiquidity or net flows
controls.interpretation: Retain already implemented reduced controls; user rejected additional requirements from item 4

fund_history.missing_for_existing_alpha_design: Longer per-fund monthly unit-value/return history and exact fund-series links; minimum 36 prior usable months within 60, plus future 1-3 months
fund_history.not_asserted: Absence of older unit values throughout the PC; original disclosures have not been exhaustively audited for this purpose

money_market_download.chosen_series: CBR RUONIA rate and RUONIA accumulated index
money_market_download.role: RF benchmark; other equity/bond factors are not supplied by this download

preservation: Protected resources, live Gemma inputs/results and prior completed regressions unchanged
